name: Spatial Watch Cloudflare Rate Limiting & Anti-Abuse Ruleset
description: Edge rate limiting rules protecting Spatial Watch against room flooding, bot session exhaustion, R2 presign abuse, and WebSocket connection storms.

rules.description: Limit Room Creation: Max 5 POST requests per 5 minutes per IP

response.content: {"error": "Too many room creation attempts. Please wait 5 minutes before creating another room."}

rules.description: Challenge Session Initialization: Max 30 GET requests per minute per IP
Limit Video Uploads: Max 3 POST requests per 10 minutes per IP for both direct presign and faststart transcoding
rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "POST" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/media/presign-upload" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/media/upload-faststart"))

response.content: {"error": "Too many video upload requests. Please wait before uploading another clip."}

rules.description: Mitigate Room Code Brute-Forcing: Max 20 POST requests per minute per IP

response.content: {"error": "Too many room join attempts. Please check the room code and try again shortly."}

rules.description: Limit WebSocket Handshake Connections: Max 10 handshakes per minute per IP

response.content: {"error": "Too many WebSocket connections. Please wait before reconnecting."}
